note: Dominica: CARICOM nationals of the listed states move freely; nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 6 months, 3 months, 90 days (Russia and Ukraine in 180), 30 or 28; every other passport enters without a visa for 21 days, except those of the Dominican Republic and Haiti, which need a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy.
